purpose: Eugene dancing beneath a disco ball, preserving the original character's beady eyes, lanky nonmuscular build, simple blocky head and banded rainbow mane.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Create ONE portrait r-cana loteria-style card-art mock-up of EUGENE, the pink humanoid unicorn, TEARING IT UP ON A DISCO DANCE FLOOR beneath a mirrored DISCO BALL. The user's most important correction is that Eugene must look MUCH CLOSER TO HIS ORIGINAL SIMPLE LOW-POLY FORM, with SMALL BEADY EYES, an ordinary lanky nonmuscular body, and his distinctive slightly awkward sweet personality. Input image 1, the newly supplied original-game screenshot, is the authoritative character reference and takes priority over all earlier interpretations. Image 2, the full-body original screenshot, supplements his pale yellow trousers, body proportions and simple pink footwear. Image 3, the screenshot of completed Trader cards, is ONLY a reference for saturated illustrated color, lighting and collectible-card richness; do not import anyone else's anatomy, clothing or expression. Do not copy screenshot interface, furniture, text or game setting.

IDENTITY — FOLLOW CLOSELY: Match Eugene's actual long, simply constructed pink horse head and unusually long narrow pink neck, pale lavender chunky muzzle with small nostrils, ONE pearlescent pastel horn, two upright simple ears. His eyes are TINY ROUND BLACK BEADS embedded at the sides of the head, with NO visible whites, NO big colored irises, NO eyelids or eyelashes, NO expressive human eyebrows and NO humanized face. Keep the plain gently open little mouth with a single understated pale tooth edge if useful, not a big human toothy grin. A short rigid blocky mane lies along the back of the neck in horizontal pastel rainbow bands of mint, pale yellow, pink and lavender; NOT the large flowing glamorous mane of previous mockups. He has narrow gently sloping shoulders, a slim ordinary torso with a slightly soft sweater silhouette, thin lanky arms and legs, relaxed human pink hands. NO muscles, bulging biceps, broad chest, heroic shoulders or bodybuilder stance. He is an earnest slightly dorky unicorn having the time of his life.

CLOTHES: His original pale icy-aqua TURTLENECK sweater with sage-mint ribbed high collar and cuffs, small purple-and-white unicorn-head emblem on the chest, butter-yellow straight-legged trousers, and simple low-profile pink shoes/feet as seen in the original full-body reference. No biker leather, sunglasses, helmet, jewelry, sequined suit, ornate costume, apron or extra accessories. Keep the original outfit recognizable; the lighting supplies the disco glamour.

ACTION AND FRAMING: Full-body energetic but physically plausible disco dance pose, large within a vertical portrait. Eugene is dancing with a wide diagonal step, knees softly bent and hips cocked to one side; one long arm reaches diagonally upward with one index finger pointing toward the disco ball, the other arm bends loosely across his waist with relaxed hand. His long neck and head tilt slightly in the opposite direction, looking roughly toward the viewer in three-quarter view, little beady eye visible. Make him charmingly uninhibited and a little awkward, not a smooth muscular dance model. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, one horn. Keep the horn, hands, pointing finger and both feet inside the image with a little breathing room. His face and chest emblem should remain readable and unobstructed. The pose must make a clear memorable silhouette at card size.

SCENE AND DEPTH: A vibrant retro disco with deep violet and midnight blue background, a few gold and hot-pink light beams, and a glossy illuminated checkerboard dance floor in magenta, turquoise, violet and warm gold, receding strongly into the background. One recognizable large silver MIRROR DISCO BALL hangs high at an upper corner, separate from his horn, throwing small square reflected light patches around the room and onto his sweater. Keep space between the pointing fingertip and the disco ball. No crowd or extra characters required. Keep the center background dark and quiet enough for his pink head, mint sweater and thin arms to stand out. In the low foreground, a few enlarged luminous floor tiles and sparse large reflected light glints establish a near plane; do not add clutter or props. Design a clear background / Eugene / foreground-floor separation for possible future parallax. One unified composite image now, not separated layers.

RENDERING: Retain the character's deliberately simple angular low-poly silhouette and face. Elevate it with the finished Trader cards' saturated colors, crisp sculpted planes, rich light and polished illustration quality WITHOUT adding human anatomical detail or excessive subdivisions to his face. Warm golden rim light on one side, cool cyan and pink disco reflections on the other. A joyful cinematic loteria collectible illustration, not photorealism, not smooth cute pony cartoon, not a raw unlit screenshot. Full-bleed 2:3 portrait approximately 1024 x 1536. No frame, text, numbers, lyrics, logos or watermark. Critical priorities: tiny black beady eyes; simple elongated original head; thin nonmuscular original body; original turtleneck and yellow trousers; exuberant disco dancing and a visible mirror ball.
